# List workspace states

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-list-workspace-states` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

Deterministic loading, empty, populated, stale refresh, and error states around one stable list workspace.

- A list surface must communicate initial load, absence, background refresh, failure, and recovery.

**Not when:**

- Do not replace domain rows with a generic component or use transient toasts as the only error record.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css.

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.
